oneOf.description: The receipt of a job run.

command.description: The command this receipt describes: always `engrave` — `cut` is the same command, and the receipt does not change with its spelling.

profileId.description: The bed profile the job was set up on (#513).

profileVersion.description: That profile’s version — the time of its last edit when the job was planned.

bed.description: The bed the job was bound to, or null for a job that names none (a design or coupon run, or a document written before jobs were bound to a bed). Omitted by receipts written before this field existed — a committed receipt parses to itself, byte for byte.

deferred.description: The comparison was deferred by the caller (--defer-ideal): this run planned the owned plan only.

anyOf.description: A comparison the run made: the line and both cycle estimates.

idealSeconds.description: The ideal plan’s cycle estimate, seconds.

line.description: #975’s comparison line, in outcome terms; null when the difference is minor.

material.description: Whether the two plans’ outcomes differ past the materiality bounds.

ownedSeconds.description: The owned plan’s cycle estimate, seconds.

comparison.description: The ideal-vs-owned comparison; omitted when the run had no ideal to compare.

anyOf.description: The coupon sweep summary, when the run was a coupon.

parameter.description: The case parameter the sweep varies.

recordFile.description: The coupon record file name the run wrote.

rowCount.description: Program rows the record carries to fill in.

values.description: The values swept, in the spec’s order.

coupon.description: The coupon summary, or null for a job or design run.

faceAngle.description: The face-angle datum a square chuck job was planned against; omitted otherwise. A new optional field does not bump RECEIPT_VERSION.

degrees.description: The square stock’s face angle — the rotary A zero — in degrees, as the bed profile’s datum states it.

residualMm.description: The levelling run’s own residual, mm, when the datum recorded one.

goal.description: The run’s combined goal check, for a goal job; omitted otherwise.

addressableFraction.description: #1165 — the share of the goal this staging’s own top setup can address, 0–1 — a DIAGNOSTIC beside the judged coverage, never the verdict. Present with `causeClass`, or when the run stated the share on a failing check.

adjudicatedFraction.description: Share of covered cells at the 0.1 mm floor AFTER edge break, wall cells and wall shadow are excluded, 0–1 — the pass line’s judged number. Wall cells and the wall shadow are excluded in every goal job; edge break only when the job states one.

adjudicatedMaxMm.description: The deepest cut among the ADJUDICATED cells, mm — after the wall, wall-shadow and (when the job states one) edge-break exclusions; 0 when none. The raw deepest cut is `maxCutIntoMm`.

borderOverReliefCells.description: #1092 (gate v8) — the same, for the grid-BORDER class.

causeClass.description: #1165 — WHY a goal verdict under the pass line missed: `setup-infeasible` (this staging cannot address enough of the goal), `shop-infeasible` (a refused floor stands beyond the longest usable cutter reach), or `plan-shortfall` (addressable and reachable, and still not cut — the only engine defect). Absent on a pass and on an unchecked comparison, so those receipts stay byte-identical.

x.description: Work-frame X of that deepest read, mm.

y.description: Work-frame Y of that deepest read, mm.

at.description: Where that deepest read is; null when none.

fraction.description: The conservative column read’s cut-into share — the one-column-lenient diagnostic.

maxMm.description: The conservative column read’s deepest cut into the goal, mm.

columnCutInto.description: The conservative column read beside the verdict, as a stated diagnostic; null when not taken.

cutIntoFraction.description: Share of the goal’s covered cells cut below it by more than the floor, 0–1.

edgeBreakFraction.description: Share of covered cells excluded as EDGE BREAK (a V bit within its reach of a design edge, no deeper than its leg), 0–1.

ladder.description: #1046 — the standard rest rungs the virtual ladder measured on this run (`--rest-ladder`); omitted when the ladder did not run. The statement beside them names the rung that takes the leftover.

cycleSeconds.description: The rung’s own finish cycle estimate, seconds.

diameterMm.description: The standard rung’s ball diameter, mm.

feedsSource.description: Where the rung’s feeds came from — a virtual rung has no catalogue row.

leftoverAboveMm.description: The deepest leftover the rung leaves, mm.

leftoverShare.description: The share of the goal the rung leaves standing, 0–1.

leftoverFractions.description: Share of the covered cells standing more than each leftover band (0.1 / 0.3 / 1 mm) above the goal.

leftoverTall.description: #1248 — the cells standing more than the shop’s `plan.leftoverTallMm` above the goal, split wall line / wall foot / open. Reported only; no rule reads it. Absent on a check that was not told the tall limit.

cellAreaMm2.description: The goal grid’s cell area, mm².

openCells.description: Every other tall cell: material standing proud away from any wall.

wallFootCells.description: Tall cells within the smallest cutter radius used of a wall-line cell’s centre: the fillet that cutter leaves.

wallLineCells.description: Tall cells whose goal height differs by ≥ 1 mm from a 4-neighbour’s: samples on near-vertical faces.

x.description: Work-frame X of the deepest cut, mm.

y.description: Work-frame Y of the deepest cut, mm.

maxCutIntoAt.description: Where the RAW deepest cut is, in the work frame, or null when nothing was cut into — before any exclusion; `adjudicatedMaxMm` is the deepest cell the pass judges.

maxCutIntoMm.description: The deepest cut into the goal, mm.

cls.description: The class that would have excused it.

mm.description: Depth below the goal at that cell, mm.

overReliefDeepest.description: #1092 (gate v8) — the deepest cell a class would have excused and which was counted instead; null when none.

passCoverage.description: The coverage the pass line asks for, 0–1 — the shop’s own `goal.passCoverage`.

ran.description: Whether the comparison ran; false is a stated gap (see `reason`), not a pass.

reason.description: Why the comparison could not run, or null when it did.

sentence.description: The report’s own sentence, as the Cut card prints it.

shadowNotScoredFraction.description: Share of covered cells excluded as WALL SHADOW (behind a wall, beyond the sweep’s reach), 0–1.

shadowOverReliefCells.description: #1092 (gate v8) — the same, for the WALL-SHADOW class.

silhouetteByWitnessCells.description: #1092 (0f’s inward-witness ruling) — silhouette cells excused because their first fully covered inward neighbour is not cut below its own design within the rule’s slack: a one-cell boundary artefact of the grid’s edge.

clDistanceMm.description: The deepest stamp’s CL distance from the outline, mm.

mm.description: Depth below the goal at the excused cell, mm.

silhouetteDeepest.description: #1092 (gate v8) — the deepest silhouette cell excused on proof; null when none.

silhouetteExcusedCells.description: #1092 (gate v8) — covered cells facing uncovered grid (the part’s silhouette) excused on proof: the read no deeper than the blank’s floor and the deepest stamp’s CL on the uncovered side, at least r − pitch from the outline.

silhouetteUnavailableCells.description: #1092 (0f’s R-a ruling) — silhouette cells COUNTED because the proof was unavailable: no stock thickness is stated, so the blank’s floor is unknown. There is no silent topZ − minZ fallback; the sentence names the count.

wallNotScoredFraction.description: Share of covered cells excluded as WALL CELLS (a cell straddling a wall step), 0–1.

wallOverReliefCells.description: #1092 (gate v8) — cut-into cells the WALL class would have excused but which were COUNTED because their depth exceeds the goal’s own relief at the cell.

cells.description: The denominator: covered cells less the named excluded underside.

coveredCells.description: Covered goal cells before the exclusion.

excludedAreaMm2.description: The excluded face’s stated area, mm²; 0 when none.

excludedCells.description: Excluded underside cells; 0 when no setup names one.

excludedFace.description: The excluded face, named; null when none.

fraction.description: Share of the goal’s whole surface reproduced after every proposed setup, 0–1.

reachedCells.description: Reached cells over the document grid, after the union.

wholeSurface.description: The whole-surface reach after every proposed setup, or null when no union was formed.

kind.description: Which input built the run: a job, a 3MF design, or a coupon spec.

outDir.description: The directory the files were written into.

anyOf.description: The two-program summary, when a rest pass ran.

leftoverAreaMm2.description: Design area still standing between the two programs, mm².

restDiameterMm.description: The second cutter’s cutting diameter, mm.

restRemovedVolumeMm3.description: Material the second program removed on its own, mm³.

roughDiameterMm.description: The first cutter’s cutting diameter, mm.

thirdToolShare.description: The leftover as a share of what the design asks for, or null.

thirdToolSuggested.description: Whether a third cutter is suggested, or null when not judged.

thirdToolThreshold.description: The shop’s third-cutter threshold, as a fraction, or null.

pair.description: The two-program summary, or null when only one program ran.

programs.description: Every program the run wrote, in the order written.

items.description: One program a run wrote.

anyOf.description: The CAM summary for one program.

baselineRapidMm.description: Rapid travel the pre-#487 ordering would have spent, mm, or null.

cutMm.description: Cutting travel, mm, or null when not recorded.

commandedFeedSeconds.description: Feed distance over commanded feed, s.

cycleSeconds.description: The cycle estimate the figures were taken from, s.

deepestCutMm.description: Deepest feed Z, mm below the stock top.

feedSeconds.description: Seconds in feed runs, through the per-run trapezoid.

hopCount.description: XY traverses at the hop height.

rapidCutRatio.description: Rapid over cutting travel, or null.

sweptAreaMm2.description: Area the cutter sweeps on its feed moves, mm², or null.

tourBoundMm.description: MST lower bound on the air path, mm, or null.

rapidMm.description: Rapid (air) travel, mm, or null when not recorded.

cam.description: The CAM summary, or null when the CAM produced none.

host.description: The machine reached, or null when nothing was sent.

port.description: The command port used (2222 on a Z1).

touched.description: Whether the probe touched (`:1`) or travelled its whole distance and hit nothing (`:0`).

prb.description: The last `[PRB:…]` the controller answered, or null when the reply carried none.

text.description: The controller’s reply to the probe line, verbatim.

probe.description: The tool-length probe’s reading, or null for another section.

anyOf.description: A status read, as the controller answered it.

alarm.description: The controller’s own alarm line, verbatim, or null.

elapsedS.description: `P:`’s third field as the controller sends it — its unit is unverified; never read as seconds.

finished.description: Whether the job has ended: percent 100 AND `Idle` — `Idle` alone appears mid-job.

line.description: The `?` status line, verbatim, or null when none came back.

percent.description: `P:`’s second field — percent complete, 100 at the end.

progressLine.description: `P:`’s first field — the line being run.

state.description: The state word at the front of the line (`Idle`, `Run`, `Alarm`, …).

status.description: The status read, or null for another section.

version.description: The firmware version the controller reports, or null.
